provenance_records.role: Supplementary Information (SI text + Suppl. Figs. S1-S8), page 19 = Suppl. Fig. S5
provenance_records.content_summary: Suppl. Fig. S5b (p.19) is the ONLY published depiction of which connecting ODN sits on which numbered helix of Driver and Follower at each axial end (blue/red dash pairing). Caption: helices numbered 0-17 in both structures; one unit must be flipped upside down to join. No scale, no coordinates, no scaffold routing.
provenance_records.pins: helix/arm placement INFERRED_CANDIDATE (digitized); pairing dashes consistent with R3 sequence pairing
provenance_records.does_not_pin: nucleotide indices, 3D coordinates, follower scaffold routing, staple body layout

provenance_records.role: engine caDNAno map + soft-hinge/ss-hinge variant maps (3 pages)
provenance_records.content_summary: caDNAno-style bitmap of the ENGINE (driver): helices 0-17 real + 18,20,21,22,23,24 fake (staple design aid); hinge = helices 6-11; 95 staples + M13; chloroalkane handle helix 15->20; biotin handles; F-soft-hinge removes staples 7,8,9,10 interrupted twice by short ss; F-ss-hinge removes all hinge-region staples. Driver-only: no follower map.
provenance_records.pins: driver design conventions and the definition of the three follower VARIANTS as engine modifications (but not their designs); F10 support
